scenes.sub: AI search for every photo & video on your Mac
scenes.say: Okay, imagine describing a memory, and this AI photo search finds the exact shot.
You just type something like happy partying, human robot, or apple device, and it instantly pulls up every match.
It's called {SCM|S C M}, Screen Memories, and it's free and open source, with {446|four hundred forty-six} stars in six days.

scenes.heading: WHAT IT *SEARCHES*
scenes.say: And it doesn't just search photos: it finds scenes inside videos, text on your screen, even spoken lines.

scenes.title: Terminal
scenes.heading: INSTALL WITH *HOMEBREW*
scenes.say: Installing it takes three lines of Homebrew.

pros: No account, no cloud, no uploads
scenes.say: The catch? It's Mac only, and there's a {435 MB|four hundred thirty-five megabyte} model to download first. But after that, there's no account, no cloud, and no uploads.
So what would you search for first? Comment {FIND|find} and I'll pin the link.

youtube.title: AI Photo Search for Mac: Describe It, Find It (Free)
youtube.description:
SCM (Screen Memories) is a free, open-source AI photo search for Mac: describe a memory and it finds the matching photos, or the exact scene inside a video. It also searches text on screen (OCR) and spoken lines (Whisper). Local-first: no account, no cloud, no uploads; the AI runs on your Mac.
The catch: macOS only (Homebrew build: Apple Silicon, macOS 12+), and the first model download is ~435 MB. After that it's fully offline.
Repo: github.com/allenv0/SCM (MIT). Demo footage from the repo.
